performance_claim_scope: Rejected W7900 planar-Q6/Q8_1 rows1-4 route and its X8-c1 sidecar rescue; component and profile improvements are diagnostic only because both complete-path designs regress true AR.
correctness_scope: GPU1 CPU/X8/residual oracle, registered dispatch, W7900 B1-B3 transaction, natural token identity and B3 acceptance identity, memory teardown, and focused post-removal regression gates.

candidate.planar_route: Q8_1 activation quantization plus planar-Q6 sudot4 at rows1-4; exact planar-Q6 WMMA retained for larger rows.
candidate.sidecar_rescue: Equal-size X8 Q6 sidecar at c1 plus planar-Q6/Q8_1 rows2-4, preserving transaction-consistent X8 arithmetic.

correctness.planar_leaf: GPU1 c1/rows2-4 across both actual wide shapes and local64/128/256 has zero X8-output bit mismatches, 20/20 top-1, and max KL 1.00e-5; residual sibling preserves the approximate projection-plus-BF16-add boundary.
correctness.sidecar_dense_entry: Selector-free dense Q6X8 c1 entry is BF16-bit identical to the selected-X8 oracle; cached rocprof names gguf_x8_selected_q8_1_dp4a_gemv_kernel<unsigned short, 6, true> at 3.720 us, local64, VGPR72, LDS512 B, scratch0.
correctness.transaction: W7900 B1-B3 logits, GPU/CPU acceptance, reject/partial/full commit, forced rollback, correction, dynamic graph reuse, provider output, 36-GiB lifecycle, ownership census, and teardown passed before performance admission.

planar_rows1_4_profile_w7900.protocol: Tracked-clean one-prompt natural25 B3 rocprofv3 kernel/marker/copy profile; explicit zero versus one.

planar_rows1_4_full_category_w7900.protocol: Tracked-clean same-commit ten-prompt natural25 true AR plus B1-B3; all code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en train and heldout categories.

rotating_x8_c1_component.protocol: All 56 production weights, one Q8_1 activation quantizer per weight, 20 warmup pairs and 21 counterbalanced HIP-event samples.

sidecar_directional_gate_w7900.protocol: Tracked-clean same-commit code_merge_intervals natural25 true AR plus B3; one run; explicit zero/zero versus planar-one/sidecar-one.

decision.reason: Both transaction-consistent c1 designs improve B3 but regress true AR by more than 6%. The sidecar also adds 3.140 GiB. The frozen gate requires both AR and B3 to improve, so the full sidecar category and populated-AR runs are intentionally skipped.
decision.code_outcome: Exact planar Q6 remains the production owner. Removed dense-runner planar-Q8 ownership and selector provenance; removed the X8 allocation/helper/registry/adapter seam and all sidecar tests. Retained the registered planar projection/residual primitive, generic q8-input adapter, dispatch memoization, and focused diagnostic fixtures.
decision.resume_condition: A byte-neutral or sole-resident c1 representation that preserves transaction-consistent rows2-4 arithmetic and beats true AR, or a materially new hardware primitive/algorithm. Do not repeat the closed planar or duplicate-X8 layouts.

post_removal_validation.parent_equivalence: Dense runner and W7900 transaction fixture match 0f6e48658^ exactly; sidecar implementation/test files match e7c0edeca^ exactly.
